statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-34743 is a heap buffer overflow in liblzma's lzma_index_append() after lzma_index_decoder() decodes an Index with no Records; XZ Utils 5.8.2 and earlier are affected and 5.8.3 fixes it (GHSA-x872-m794-cxhv, https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/security/advisories/GHSA-x872-m794-cxhv, fix commit https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/commit/c8c22869e780ff57c96b46939c3d79ff99395f87, release https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/releases/tag/v5.8.3). Alpine lists it under 5.8.3-r0 in the 3.23-stable main/xz APKBUILD secfixes (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/xz/APKBUILD). This owner's Alpine 3.23 builds are 5.8.1-r0, 5.8.2-r0, 5.8.3-r0 and 5.8.4-r0. On x86_64 and aarch64, the liblzma in the 5.8.3-r0 and 5.8.4-r0 xz-libs packages is liblzma.so.5.8.3 and liblzma.so.5.8.4, and their xz programs report XZ Utils 5.8.3 and 5.8.4, so both carry the fix. The 5.8.1-r0 and 5.8.2-r0 builds ship XZ Utils 5.8.1 and 5.8.2 and are affected.

CVE-2026-34743 is a heap buffer overflow in liblzma, the XZ Utils compression library, in XZ Utils 5.8.2 and earlier: if lzma_index_decoder() decodes an Index that contains no Records, a later lzma_index_append() on the result allocates too little memory and writes past it. Upstream fixed it in XZ Utils 5.8.3 with https://github.com/tukaani-project/xz/commit/c8c22869e780ff57c96b46939c3d79ff99395f87 and notes that the lzma_index functions are rarely used directly by applications (https://tukaani.org/xz/index-append-overflow.html). Debian backported the fix to trixie in xz-utils 5.8.1-1+deb13u1 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-34743, Debian bug #1132497). The DHI xz-utils packages are built from Debian's later 5.8.1-1+deb13u2 source, and the changelog shipped in the published liblzma5 package carries the 5.8.1-1+deb13u1 entry 'CVE-2026-34743: Buffer overflow in lzma_index_append()'. Every xz-utils build currently published in the DHI Debian repository is built from that source, so the fixed version is the lowest published build. Earlier builds made from Debian's 5.8.1-1 source do not contain the fix.
